verifiedBehavior: Additive050 preserves users and prior receipts across reopen and enforces case-insensitive uniqueness.
Unverified secondary addresses cannot authenticate; one-use confirmation links mark exactly one address verified and reject replay.
Verified secondary addresses support password login, invitation/OIDC/assignee lookup and account recovery.
Promoting a secondary address atomically moves the prior primary into verified secondary state; deletion protects the current primary.
Purpose-specific verification mail, strict API input, current-user/me authorization and public confirmation redirect are exercised.
